svg.title: Working out what each product is
svg.desc: Four layers, cheapest first: openFDA lookup resolves 28,966 NDCs, rules 4,651, a model through LiteLLM the remaining 2,432, and a person reviews anything flagged. Measured once on 162 answers: same drug 95%, brand names 96%, reproducible from a committed fixture.
svg.text: who works out what a product is? cheapest first.
a model, only for what is
a strength not in the text is thrown away
a brand's ingredient comes from memory, so it is flagged
spend is capped, and every answer is cached
